item.title: Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — Autumn Harvest Stay: 1 Night + 2 Waterpark/Fantasy Island Tickets, from ¥699
item.description: Autumn-limited stay at Wuhan's Kaiyuan Senbo waterpark resort: 1 night in a superior garden-view room, 2 buffet breakfasts, 2 tickets to the indoor water park or Fantasy Island kids' park, plus travel photography, welcome fruit and mini-bar drinks.
